what: Hovering a strip with only one big letter between top and bottom lines spreads a dark panel from the strip’s spot horizontally in .7s (.32,.48,0,1) and vertically from .25 → 1 in .7s power2.inOut. After .4s the cards rise from 60% below at .04s intervals over .7s and light up. When the pointer leaves the strip and panel, it rewinds along the same path. It is a strip that keeps five contact branches folded away.

options.dur: Duration for the panel to spread and cards to rise (sec), default .7
options.delay: Delay from panel spread until the card rises (s), default .4
options.rise: Distance the card rises (% of its own height), default 60
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Spreading panel (child) — if none, only the card rises
options.[data-fx-part=contents]: Layer holding the panels and cards (optional) — pointer-events is turned off so it takes no interaction while closed

note: On touch devices (hover false) the panel is hidden and the card is shown as is — the original also always shows the card below 991px width. The card’s own hover gets a separate part such as fill-swap-hover (look: rise-through).

from.where: Contact band at the end of every page (.contact__link · contactDirection)
